title: Degraded checkout
description: Synthetic monitor: orders-api p95 latency reached 2.3s (normally ~127ms) and error rate peaked at 14.1%.
root_cause_detail: payment-api responded slowly (CPU throttling on its node pool), so orders-api calls timed out at 5000ms. The degradation was intermittent (flapping).
expected_symptoms: orders-api downstream_latency_ms rises from ~83ms to ~2.7s (client timeout 5000ms)
timeout and retry logs on calls from orders-api to payment-api
orders-api p95 latency rises to ~2.3s, error rate up to ~14.1%
orders-api CPU and memory stay near baseline
payment-api server-side latency elevated while its CPU and memory stay normal
resolution: Moved payment-api pods off the degraded node pool and tuned the orders-api circuit breaker.
